description: This file defines the React component for the note editing page in a web application. It manages fetching existing note data, handling form submission to update the note, and rendering the editing UI with loading and error states.

methods.name: NoteEditPage
methods.description: React functional component allowing users to edit an existing note, handle loading and error states, and submit updates.

methods.name: onSubmit
methods.description: Function called when the note form is submitted; it updates the note and navigates to its detail page.
